overview: Three books lay signed for Richmond: the twenty-sixth, the twenty-seventh, and the twenty-eighth. Love's Labour's Lost, the lovers, and the Errors. No book of the king was on the table, and you did not put one there.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the three titles and left the king unfetched.

parties.name: Edmund Tilney
parties.context: Had signed, and was already turned away.
